ledger_ref.description: diagnostic stop-stage at PCI entry and before power sleep

semantics.summary: Exact root-only arm commands reuse the independent devres probe state and PM/remove mutex. pci-entry aborts before the device suspend sequence. pre-power-sleep executes the original DMA suspend, then aborts before any power/IRQ/PCI change, and is rejected for the active-channel-release DMA variant. Both return -ECANCELED, reset the PVR resume counter before PM core unwinds the already-suspended children, and preserve a consumed checkpoint until explicit re-arm. Only a successfully stopped checkpoint can re-arm; failed/armed states and ordinary HAL probes remain fail-closed. No R5 fix or runtime recovery is claimed.

license.evidence: Three existing vendor Dual MIT/GPLv2 source files; original diagnostic code only. No new dependency, binary transformation or third-party code. Mechanical license audit does not unblock driver-source or release licensing.

dependencies.summary: Requires the 030-031 markers, 030-028 PVR counter and 030-033 independent devres state. Original reg-read/monitor-cycle confirmation token remains unchanged.

o_stage_adaptation.summary: No D-side source. Shared hal.h is byte-identical to i5; struct dev_rsrc remains byte-identical to i3. All shipped objects are unchanged. The DMA build-variant query is source-visible and adds no shared layout field. Diagnostic removal must reverse 030-034, 030-033 and 030-032 in that order before the existing seven-layer publication gate.

apply.result: Three files; strict dry-run and fresh replay pass; canonical manifest after hash matches; no .orig/.rej.

rollback.command: Re-extract the locked i5 17-entry snapshot; never edit F0 or archived i5 artifacts

checks: strict dry-run and fresh i5 replay; exact three-file scope; no patch artifacts
17 checks including compiled actual write/PCI callback, both DMA build variants, and reverse 034/033/032 to the i3 locked tree with no diagnostic source tokens
two full offline 6.12.101+deb13-amd64 builds pass with BTF dev_rsrc size 140536/member count 115/offset gate; identical deb bytes
hal.h byte-identical to i5; no shared structure insertion

runtime.required: After qoder/dsh review, supervised i6 healthy boot: bound+headless pm_test=devices only, pci-entry then pre-power-sleep. Persist each round and confirm full child recovery, Driver/Firmware/PCI/DRM health and pm_test=none/pm_debug_messages=0 before re-arm. Thirty seconds without return or any recovery fault stops the batch. R5 remains FAIL.
